premise.claim: Changing spec.worker.tieredStore on an existing CacheRuntime updates the runtime ConfigMap but not the worker Pod. The quota ends up recorded as two different values, and no event, condition or log line says so. (issue #6192)
premise.evidence: results/base-premise-unit.txt: on base 86e3adf3 the ConfigMap quota follows the edited spec (16Gi) while the worker ASTS volume keeps 8Gi and zero events are emitted; the canary flips on head 58afa3a9 with the expected RuntimeTieredStoreConflict warning.

liveNote: L3 (skipped per debate setup): on a real cluster, edit spec.worker.tieredStore on an existing CacheRuntime and confirm `kubectl get events --field-selector reason=RuntimeTieredStoreConflict` shows the warning, re-emitted at >=10min intervals while drift persists. Note: verify_pr6219_envtest_test.go needs envtest binaries (KUBEBUILDER_ASSETS or ~/.local/share/kubebuilder-envtest) and self-skips without them.
polarityNotes: P0-silent is the premise canary: PASSES on base (premise reproduced) and FAILS on the fixed head (fix works); keep as differential record. Round 2 (head b56db670): F1/F2/F3 were re-polarized from canaries to CONTRACTS because the fixes landed as text/comparison/docs changes the round-1 canaries could not observe: F1 pins the remediation wording (event message + en/zh docs must say 'delete and recreate the CacheRuntime', never 'recreate the worker'), F2 pins medium-only detection, F3 pins the docs' worker-only scope. Retired round-1 canaries (still in the tree, intentionally NOT in findings): TestVerifyPR6219MediumOnlyEditInvisibleToDriftCheck (FLIPPED red on b56db670 = blind spot closed, superseded by the F2 contract), TestVerifyPR6219RemediationDeleteWorkerWorkloadDoesNotHeal (stays green: pins the pre-existing no-self-heal behavior, now unreferenced by any guidance), TestVerifyPR6219ClientTieredStoreEditSilent (stays green: pins pre-existing client silence, detection deferred to issue #6221). The PR's own ginkgo suite requires -gcflags='all=-N -l' (gomonkey); without it 35 specs fail on base and head alike (pre-existing). Round 3 (head 6809f62f): TS-DISPATCH-PRECEDENCE (round-2 question, Copilot C4368713436) is FIXED by the dispatch-order flip in checkWorkerTieredStoreDrift (HostPath now precedes EmptyDir, matching cm.go extractTieredStoreLevels); pinned by contract TestVerifyPR6219DispatchMatchesConfigMapExtraction — bite-checked by restoring the round-2 order, which silences the warning on a both-fields level ('expected a RuntimeTieredStoreConflict warning event, got events: []'). R3-HOSTPATH-STEADY is a new no-false-positive guard for hostPath levels under the hostPath-first dispatch (creation rejects multi-medium levels, so hostPath volumes at steady state must never warn).
